source_context: Shared native SQLite changes rusqlite default deferred transactions to TransactionBehavior::Immediate before reading/writing. Source test uses independent connections and zero busy timeout to observe early writer contention. Final OH storage delegates RuntimeSqliteHost to this NativeRuntimeStorageHost; pinned snapshots establish applicability, not OH execution. SQLite official transaction, busy-handler and isolation documentation cross-checked for deadlock-related skipped busy handlers, stale WAL snapshots and transaction-state handling. Isolated local macOS Python SQLite experiment reproduces BUSY_SNAPSHOT and early BEGIN IMMEDIATE BUSY, then rollback/restart/reread; not upstream Rust or packaged OH validation. Original guidance only, no application implementation copied.
